metadata.mechanics: Allows for 2-5 willing Targets (Both) with Criminal Influence (Murder Inc 1+) to spend 1 Resolve each and engage in a module against Target NPC that has just entered the Mortis. Must be registered with all willing Target Murder Inc members at logistics within 10 minutes of the Target entering. If Target NPC is trapped in the Mortis for longer, 20 minutes of prep time is allowed instead.
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: There are those that dive into the Mortis to save others, and then there are those who dive to kill again. Conducting a Murder Dive requires a certain mindset – one that can push both death and morality aside. In order to prepare a body, an individual first needs to preserve the corpse with a high-proof hooch so that it doesn’t immediately sink into the ground. Then, they must cut into the corpse and extract their heart. They and all others who are about to enter the Mortis must then consume the corpse’s heart before it disintegrates.
